text:
maya (People Ops): Hey team — just spotted a bunch of offer scorecards in Greenhouse that got replaced with the generic template after last night's integration deploy. Anyone else?
jamie (Senior Recruiter): I saw that on two reqs, yes. Interviewers opened the scorecard and it was empty besides the header.
sarah (Hiring Ops): We rolled a patch to the ATS webhook mapping at 02:13 UTC. I thought it was only metadata fields. rolling it back now.
ats-bot: [deploy] integration-service v3.4.1 deployed by sarah at 02:13 UTC
maya (People Ops): Ugh. Can we recover the previous scorecard questions? We need them for ongoing interviews today.
jamie (Senior Recruiter): Greenhouse has a change_history endpoint. I can pull the previous templates if we have API keys.
leo (Eng Manager): Heads up, we have two interviews in 45m that rely on the technical rubric. If we can't restore, ask interviewers to use the attached PDF rubric.
nish (Recruiter Intern): I DM'd the interviewers asking them to proceed with notes + score out of 5 for each section.
sarah (Hiring Ops): rollback done. Integration-service v3.4.0 deployed at 02:21 UTC.
ats-bot: [deploy] integration-service v3.4.0 rolled back by sarah at 02:21 UTC
jamie (Senior Recruiter): I pulled the templates via `GET /v1/templates/{id}/history` and re-applied them to the reqs.
maya (People Ops): Thank you. Two action items: 1) Run a one-off backfill to restore any scorecards created between 02:13-02:21 UTC. 2) Create a runbook for ATS webhook deploys (include a smoke test for scorecard templates).
leo (Eng Manager): Happy to review the runbook — let's make the smoke test part of deploy gating.
jamie (Senior Recruiter): Also recommend quick training reminder to interviewers: where to find the rubric PDF in the candidate packet and how to mark scores manually if template fails.
maya (People Ops): Agreed. Sarah, can you own the runbook and backfill?
sarah (Hiring Ops): Yes. I'll open a ticket in JIRA and ping infra for DB snapshots. ETA for backfill: 6 hours.
maya (People Ops): Great. I'd like a short 1-paragraph email we can send to hiring managers explaining what happened and steps taken. Jamie — can you draft?
jamie (Senior Recruiter): On it. Draft in #people-ops-drafts in 30m.
nish (Recruiter Intern): Learned today: always keep PDF rubrics synced to Google Drive. :memo:
maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Keeping thread open until backfill complete. :thumbsup:
